purpose: A small historical-root diagnostic conditional on the registered training and public-entry gates. Two real original response pairs, no new full maps. Results apply to a single changed joint order followed by the frozen Sapling parent in both arms.
root_pool: In manifest.json, sort held sapling_visited cards by (terrain,id). Pick the first card and the first distinct-terrain opposite-seat card where available. No substitutes. For each card, walk the original historical transcript from t=0. Select the earliest t=270..285 at which pure student and parent actually issue distinct legal joint orders. If any selected map has no divergence, report no opportunity and cancel the root experiment. No outcomes select a root.
eligibility: fit.json registered held gate and packaged public-entry normal-history test pass. Require genuine changes for both source roots before any opponent continuations.
arms: At each selected t, parent or student supplies a single actual legal action. Both sides continue with the identical pure original Sapling parent afterwards. A new Master3s2 computes its own action at the root from the common preceding history and again at every later turn. Full-clock independent processes, no stored enemy action replay after the split. Reference search may differ between arms due to wall time even with common RNG; record those differences.
clock: Only after earlier registered native queue clears; existing shared native flock, pins 0/1 symmetrically across the two paired maps, original Master3s2 with _TEMP=1,_S_ABORT=0.58,_RX enabled and _SEARCH_OK verified. Equal measured warm profile and a fixed independent diagnostic RNG per root, never original state reused from the diverged future. Record search counts and time. One common diagnostic stream per physical map. No use of these states as fresh competitions or independent whole games.
acceptance: Both distinct roots must have strictly positive candidate-minus-parent official terminal margin to merit consideration of a fresh development map. One nonpositive or missing arm stops escalation. Do not change threshold, substitute a root, or repeat a losing stream. One or two positive diagnostic pairs do not establish a win rate.
